snapshot.capital_scaled: ₹30 lakh–1 crore for a wider range, stock and retail presence
snapshot.distribution_note: Instagram and marketplaces work; no size problem means low returns

tailwinds: Bags, wallets and travel accessories have no size issues, so returns are low.
Travel is booming, driving demand for luggage and organisers.
Kolkata, Kanpur, Mumbai and Delhi have skilled leather and bag workshops.
Buyers want vegan leather, sustainable and handcrafted options.
headwinds: Big brands like Caprese, Lavie and American Tourister are strong.
angle_2026: Travel and work have made bags an everyday purchase, and buyers want better design than cheap imports offer. In 2026, bag and accessory brands grow by owning a need, such as travel organisation, laptop bags or handcrafted leather, and building a recognisable design.
cost_basis: Estimated for a brand working with a contract workshop and selling online, 2026 prices.

unit_economics.note: Low returns make bags more profitable than clothing.

bootstrap_takeaway: Start with 5–8 designs, produce small batches, and reorder what sells.
sourcing_edge: Kolkata (leather goods), Kanpur and Agra (leather), Mumbai's Dharavi (bags) and Delhi make small batches. Working directly with workshops cuts costs.
licences: Correct labelling of material and maker

hard_truths.title: Copies
hard_truths.text: Designs are easily copied. Build a brand, not just a product.

hard_truths.title: Quality
hard_truths.text: Stitching and zips fail. Inspect every batch.

hard_truths.title: Cheap imports
hard_truths.text: Compete on design and quality, not price.

hard_truths.title: Stock
hard_truths.text: Colours and styles that don't sell tie up cash.

plan_goal: The aim is ₹1.5 lakh in sales with a clear best-selling design.
